challenges.subject: English
challenges.title: Reading Detective
challenges.prompt: A passage says a school library is quiet, contains many books, and lets students borrow them. What is its main idea?
choices: Libraries help students read and learn.
Reading is only done at home.
challenges.explanation: The main idea summarizes what the whole passage explains.

challenges.subject: Mathematics
challenges.title: Math Lab
challenges.prompt: A classroom has 24 students. One quarter are in the science lab. How many students are in the lab?
challenges.explanation: One quarter means divide by four: 24 ÷ 4 = 6.

challenges.subject: Biology
challenges.title: Science Investigator
challenges.prompt: Which cell structure makes most ATP during aerobic cellular respiration?
challenges.explanation: Mitochondria produce most ATP during aerobic respiration.

challenges.subject: City Skills
challenges.title: Safe Streets
challenges.prompt: When crossing a busy avenue to reach school, what should you do?
choices: Use a marked crossing and check for traffic.
challenges.explanation: Use marked crossings and check approaching traffic.
